artworks.title: Coat of Arms with a Rampant Lion
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a heraldic emblem. The image features a coat of arms centered around a helmet with wings. The helmet has a plume, and a lion is depicted in the shield below it. The emblem is enclosed in a circular frame with an inscription. The drawing shows detailed line work and shading techniques. A date is inscribed at the bottom of the circle.

artworks.title: Coat of Arms with a Cock
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a coat of arms featuring a rooster. The image showcases an intricate design centered around a heraldic shield. At the top, there is a rooster standing atop a crowned helm. Scroll banners curve around the top and bottom of the image with inscriptions. The crest is flanked by ornate foliage and scrollwork, enriching the design. Below the helm, the shield bears another depiction of a rooster. The style and technique indicate a detailed engraving typical of European heraldic art from the Renaissance period.

artworks.title: Coat of Arms with an Eagle
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a heraldic emblem featuring a helmet with ornate decorations and a bird. The image depicts a detailed medieval-style helmet adorned with a crown-like top and flanked by large plumes. Surrounding the helmet are elaborate scrolls, and foliage motifs creating an intricate frame. Below the helmet, a shield displays an eagle or bird with outstretched wings, a common heraldic symbol. The style of the drawing emphasizes ornate detail and craftsmanship, reminiscent of historical engravings and heraldic illustrations. Decorative banners with text are also included, adding to the heraldic context of the piece.

artworks.title: Christ Crowned with Thorns Speaking with His Mother
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals from the waist up. The figure on the left faces the viewer, with distinct facial features and angular headwear. They wear draped fabric and raise their hands towards the middle of the image. The figure on the right is seen in a profile view, facing the left figure, with wavy hair and a crown made of curved elements. They appear shirtless, displaying muscular shoulders and a back with linear etching. The background features radiating lines emphasizing the figures, especially around the head of the right figure, creating a halo effect.

artworks.title: Christ Crowned with Thorns Speaking with His Mother
Ecclesia Antichristi
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group seated around a table engaged in discussion or examination of objects. The image features various figures in period clothing with decorative elements such as trees and leaves above. A figure points with a long staff towards items scattered on the table, including papers and a plate. The upper section of the image is labeled "ECCLESIA ANTICHRISTI." The drawing's style suggests careful attention to linework and detail.

artworks.title: Saturn
artworks.artist: Theodor de Bry, after Sebald Beham
artworks.description: This is a print of a man holding a child, surrounded by clouds. The man is turned slightly towards the right, with light skin, a beard, and a wide-brimmed hat. His chest is partially covered by a garment that drapes off one shoulder and is tied around his waist, and his legs are bare. In one hand he holds the child, and in the other he holds the handle of an enormous scythe, the blade of which curves down from the left towards his feet. Sitting on the ground to the left is a goat, and on the right is a man with what appears to be a scaly tail, who pours out a jug of water into the bottom right corner of the print. Rays of light emanate from around the central man, and he is surrounded by swirling clouds. There is a curling banner with "SATVRNVS" written above the figure and the text "AVREI SAECVLI PRINCEPS" below.

artworks.title: Jupiter
artworks.artist: Theodor de Bry, after Sebald Beham
artworks.description: The image features a figure standing confidently in an upright position. The figure has a full beard and is wearing a helmet with a plume. They wear short, classical-style armor with exposed lower legs and a belted skirt. The figure holds a scepter in one hand and a cluster of objects in the other. A smaller, seated, winged figure holding a spear is beside them. The background includes stylized clouds, and a banner above the figure reads "IVP PITER," designating them as Jupiter, the Roman god. A Latin inscription is at the bottom of the image.

artworks.title: Mars
artworks.artist: Theodor de Bry, after Sebald Beham
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a figure holding a sword and a torch, surrounded by symbolic elements. The central figure, viewed from behind, has curly hair and a cloth draped over the lower body. In one hand, the figure holds a curved sword, and in the other hand, a torch is raised. The background is filled with swirling clouds, and at the top, a scrolling banner with the word "MARS." A star with trailing lines is seen in the upper right. Below the figure, there is a scorpion and a reclining ram surrounded by clouds. The bottom of the drawing features the text "BELLORVM AVTOR." The lines and shading suggest a meticulous technique. The composition and iconography allude to war and strength themes associated with the deity Mars.

artworks.title: Sun
artworks.artist: Theodor de Bry, after Sebald Beham
artworks.description: This image shows a mythological figure holding a sun mask. The figure is in classical style, standing with one arm raised holding a mask with a sun face, and the other arm holding a rod or scepter. The figure wears armor and a crown, surrounded by clouds. Beneath the figure is a resting lion. Above the figure is a ribbon with the word "SOL." The illustration features stippling and line work to accentuate textures and shading.

artworks.title: Venus
artworks.artist: Theodor de Bry, after Sebald Beham
artworks.description: The image depicts a full-body view of an individual shown from the back, standing barefoot on a cloud. The person's body is slightly turned to the left, with their head also looking to the left, allowing a profile view of their face. Their facial features are delicate, with closely cropped, curly hair that appears to be held by a thin band or net. The figure is wearing a draped garment that leaves their arms and part of their upper back exposed, and it flows gracefully around their legs. In their left hand, they hold a five-pointed star, and in the right hand, a three-pronged spear or staff. A serene-looking cow lies on the ground next to them. The background is filled with stylized clouds, and above the figure, a ribbon unfurls bearing the inscription "VENVS." At the bottom of the image, the words "VOLUPTATUM PAREN" are inscribed.

artworks.title: Mercury
artworks.artist: Theodor de Bry, after Sebald Beham
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a classical figure surrounded by cherubic forms and symbols. The central figure is depicted with a winged helmet and a staff known as a caduceus. This character stands prominently with a majestic posture, blowing a horn or similar instrument. Two smaller, cherubic beings accompany the figure — one to the left with a mythical half-fish and half-human form holding a flower and a small caduceus, while the other to the right embraces another child-like figure. They all float amidst stylized clouds. Above the main figure, a banner unfurls with the inscription "MERCVRIVS," and below is written “MERCATORVM FAVTOR."

artworks.title: Moon
artworks.artist: Theodor de Bry, after Sebald Beham
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing upright in a frontal position. They have short, curly hair and a classic facial expression. The person is wearing a draped garment that falls above their knees, cinched at the waist. They are holding a crescent moon with a face in one hand and a long staff in the other. A floating ribbon above their head reads "LVNA." The person is barefoot, with no visible jewelry. The background consists of swirling clouds. The engraving includes the initials "I-SB" in the bottom left corner and the words "NOCTIS DOMINA" at the bottom.

artworks.title: Two Lover Seated in Front of a Fence
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to image): 12.7 x 8.7 cm (5 x 3 7/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image displays two individuals embracing from the waist up. The person on the left wears a dress with decorative patterns and hair styled with some covering, along with a necklace. The individual on the right wears a hat with a broad brim and a shirt with puffed sleeves. The environment includes dense foliage, a stylized tree, and a distinctive landscape in the background. Stylized clouds fill the sky. The image includes the initials "I&P".

artworks.title: Bust of an Old Bearded Man
artworks.description: The image depicts an illustration of a person's upper body, focusing on their facial features. The individual is in a three-quarter view, with a beard, curly hair, and a robe. The background is plain, with text at the top of the image.

artworks.title: Saint Erasmus as Bishop
artworks.description: The image depicts a person dressed in ecclesiastical attire, wearing a mitre and an ornate robe with a stole. They hold a staff in each hand with curled ends. Surrounding the figure are stylized natural elements like leafy branches above and a landscape in the background with hills and trees.

artworks.title: The Holy Family Under a Tree
artworks.description: This print shows a partial view of two adults and a child near a tall tree. In the center, a woman sits or leans against the trunk of the tree, holding a child in her arms. She wears long clothing that drapes in thick folds and fills most of the bottom of the print, obscuring her body. Her long, curling hair cascades down her shoulders below the cloth that covers her head and neck. Her face is in profile as she looks to the right at the man next to her. The man stands beside the tree on the right, and we see him from the waist up, behind the woman's long skirts. The man has a beard and curling hair and is clothed in a draped garment that is open in the center to reveal his bare chest. His right hand is bent above his head with the middle two fingers extended downward, while his left hand rests on the top of a bottle that sits on an unseen surface. The child in the woman's arms is naked, and lays horizontally in her arms, holding a round object that may be an apple. All three of the people have light skin and light hair. Behind them is the tall tree, with twisted branches and flat leaves extending from it. The sky behind is blank, and the background of the print is beige paper.

artworks.title: The Last Supper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures seated at a table in a vaulted interior. The scene depicts an architectural setting with ornate vaulted ceilings supported by columns. There is a round table at the center, at which several figures are gathered, engaged in conversation and possibly dining. The use of hatching and cross-hatching creates texture and shading, giving depth to the architectural elements and the figures. The figures are shown with a variety of gestures, some holding cups or other objects. At the back, through an arched window, a distant landscape is visible. The drawing possesses a style reminiscent of Renaissance-era woodcuts, characterized by detailed linework and careful attention to the contrast between light and shadow.

artworks.title: The Agony in the Garden
artworks.description: The image shows a central person standing with both arms raised. They have a long beard, aged appearance, long hair, and wear a robe. Three other individuals are around them, reclining or lying on the ground. The setting is an outdoor scene with detailed trees and vegetation. There are initials "I.SP" in the top right corner.

artworks.title: The Betrayal of Christ
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a gathering of individuals in a wooded area. The style is reminiscent of woodcut prints. The figures are shown in animated poses, with some holding torches and others with swords or spears. Each character is depicted with rich detail, from their facial expressions down to their textured hair and clothing. The scene captures a variety of actions, with individuals gesturing, leaning, or standing among trees and foliage.

artworks.title: Christ before Caiaphas
artworks.description: This is a detailed woodcut-style drawing of a scene with several figures in a historical or narrative setting. The composition features stylized architectural elements like arches and columns, with figures depicted in expressive postures and clothing. The scene suggests a discussion or confrontation, with spears and banners present.

artworks.title: Ecce Homo
artworks.description: The image is a detailed black and white engraving showing multiple figures within a complex architectural setting. The individuals are depicted mostly in full or half-body views, with varied positions such as standing. Their facial features are meticulously rendered with prominent outlines and shadowing. The figures are adorned in intricate medieval-style clothing with elements such as puffed sleeves and patterned armor, suggesting a scene possibly set in a historical or fantasy context. Several hold swords and other weaponry. In the background, there are arched structures and columns with decorative capitals, creating a sense of depth. The overall composition conveys a narrative scene rich with details and elaborate costumes, set against an imposing architectural backdrop.

artworks.title: Christ Bearing the Cross
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group scene. The composition shows several figures gathered under an arched stone structure with expressions and postures suggesting a moment of confrontation. The central figure is among others who are gesturing towards them, potentially with implements raised. The figures are detailed with intricate shading and lines, typical of woodcut or engraving techniques. The style is similar to Hans Sebald Beham.

artworks.title: Christ on the Cross
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a crucifixion scene. The image features a central figure on a cross with a sign above, surrounded by various figures, some holding weapons, and a lush tree in the background. The drawing showcases detailed line work in black ink, giving a dramatic and intense portrayal of the scene with strong contrast and intricate details. The landscape and figures are stylized with patterns of shading that emphasize the emotions and actions within the scene.
